status: COMPLETE actual original Dirichlet free-projection convergence in physical L2-to-essential-supremum, L2-to-continuous-uniform and L2 operator norms; uniform on every FIXED H-minus-one compact set; actual source-normalized eigenfunction/mass bounds and exact free factor-two sine kernel. Periodic projection convergence, C.4 logarithmic rate, full (31)/(32), complex weighted midpoint and ALL MAIN theorems remain OPEN.
results: The ordinary physical Lebesgue Lp class of a closed-unit-interval continuous curve is constructed for EVERY 1<=p<=infinity, with operator bound EXACTLY ONE because the original interval has measure one. Its representative is the IDENTICAL original curve a.e. On the ENTIRE native zero-trace H1 domain its p=2 realization is EXACTLY the original ordinary physical L2 inclusion.

The LITERAL sine sin(n*pi*x) is realized by an ACTUAL NONZERO free native H1 eigenfunction at the SAME original positive index and energy (pi*n)^2. Its uniform norm is at most one and its complex BILINEAR physical square integral is EXACTLY ONE HALF. No normalized Fourier or smaller native-domain model replaces the original interval problem.

The actual sine-comparison error delta<=1/16 gives explicit ACTUAL physical bounds: 1/2<=norm(g)_L2<=2, norm(g)_uniform<=2, abs(J(g)(g)-1/2)<=3*delta and abs(J(g)(g))>=1/4. The complex bilinear mass lower bound is DERIVED, not supplied, and no reality premise is used.

Rescaling the ACTUAL sine-close eigenfunction gives the SOURCE unit unnormalized physical L2 norm, literal norm-square integral one, uniform norm <=4 and COMPLEX bilinear mass >=1/16. ONE original complex H-minus-one neighborhood and cutoff provide these normalized eigenfunctions and bounds for ALL nearby sources and ALL subsequent ORIGINAL indices.

For the SAME literal source circle |z-(pi*n)^2|=n, the ACTUAL source contour projection differs from the ACTUAL zero-potential contour operator by at most 40*delta in the physical L2-to-continuous-uniform operator norm whenever the actual sine error is at most delta<=1/16. The existing exact rank-one kernels and NEW derived physical denominator bounds prove this quantitative error transfer.

The ACTUAL source contour projection from ALL ordinary physical L2 data into ordinary physical essential-supremum L-infinity is CONSTRUCTED. Its output is the IDENTICAL physical function a.e. as the actual original L2 contour projection. Both L2-to-Linfinity and L2 operator-norm differences are bounded by the ACTUAL continuous-output uniform difference with constant exactly one.

For EVERY original complex H-minus-one source and prescribed epsilon>0, ONE original norm-open neighborhood and cutoff make ALL high ACTUAL Dirichlet source projections epsilon-close to the ACTUAL free contour projection in ALL THREE physical operator norms. All circle validity, same-index isolation, simplicity, actual nonzero eigenfunction comparison and denominator bounds are PROVED; none is supplied in this convergence theorem.

On EVERY FIXED COMPACT set in the original H-minus-one norm, the ACTUAL Dirichlet source projections converge UNIFORMLY to the ACTUAL free projection in ALL THREE physical operator norms. The compact set is fixed BEFORE epsilon, and one threshold works before ALL sources and ALL later original positive indices. A verified finite-cover compact-threshold theorem upgrades the prescribed-tolerance neighborhood result.

The ACTUAL zero-potential source contour operator is identified pointwise on the CLOSED original interval with the literal kernel 2*(integral F(y)*sin(pi*n*y)dy)*sin(pi*n*x), for ALL physical L2 data and ALL sufficiently high original indices. The factor TWO is proved from the actual physical sine square integral ONE HALF.

The original article adapters retain the ENTIRE original complex physically period-one H-minus-one distribution, arbitrary mean allowed, and an OPEN neighborhood in the ORIGINAL ambient norm. They prove the DIRICHLET part of source (33), including genuine ordinary L2-to-essential-supremum o(1) and the ordinary L2 o(1) needed in (34), and uniform convergence on every FIXED compact original H-minus-one set. The periodic part of (33) and the fractional-Sobolev logarithmic C.4 rate remain OPEN.
essential_remaining: Prove the periodic projection/basis/off-diagonal estimates of source Lemma 2.13 and the PERIODIC part of (33). Combine with the NEW proved DIRICHLET part of (33), source-normalized actual Dirichlet eigenfunction bounds and exact free sine kernel to prove the source overlap lower bound (32). Complete the periodic eta/gamma residual representation in (31) and Lemma 2.15.

Prove the precise Appendix C.4 periodic/Dirichlet rate C_t*(log n)^2/n^(1-abs(t)) for -1<t<-1/2, with the source norm dependence and locally uniform threshold. The NEW full-H-minus-one Dirichlet o(1) on each fixed source and uniform convergence on compact sets do NOT supply that rate or uniform convergence on one fixed infinite-dimensional H-minus-one norm neighborhood.

Prove FULL COMPLEX source Theorem 2.1(ii) general-weight midpoint membership/local boundedness; complete low periodic simplicity/interlacing/parity and complex ratio 2.20 where used; construct ORIGINAL KdV Birkhoff maps and actual H-minus-one smooth-approximation flow. ALL FIVE MAIN THEOREMS 1.1,1.3,1.4,5.1,5.9 remain UNPROVED; goal ACTIVE. Source 2.2(i)-(iii), Lemma 2.21 and Appendix B remain proved.
